notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[p][b]And here comes the demo update![/b] 
In this update, I fixed 1 critical bug and several minor ones, and also added the E̷̡͍̘͍͌̋͆͛̀̏͂̇̚n̵̛̺̰͚̮̻̼̰͉̈́̈́̈́̄͆̿͘͠͠t̶̛̛̯͔̫͉͚̤̎̐̒̀͂͝͝͠i̷͚̠̿͗͂͐̄̿̇̍͆̓t̶̨͎̪͍̱̼̖̲̩͗̒̈́̾͆̈́̓̔̽́͝ͅý̶̬̗͚̙̝͙̩̈́͋̋̽̓͛̀̅̐̔̽̇̈́̕͠͝͝ 
Now it will be much harder not to notice it.[/p]

notes.title: Demo is Live!
notes.content: [p]You can now play the [b]Coincidences?[/b] demo. Heads up: this early build may contain bugs and localization issues. I’ll keep patching it to improve the experience and add new details.[/p]
